svg.title: Skivu — Your world. Your way.
svg.desc: Galaxy artwork generated for Skivu, with a slow cinematic drift, breathing starlight and occasional meteors. Stable typography and the approved logo. Static background for reduced-motion preferences.

g.font-family: Segoe UI,Microsoft YaHei,Noto Sans CJK SC,Arial,sans-serif
g.text: Models, characters, and a little more you.
